The rally was scheduled for January. It will now be held "in a different territory" to be announced later before a planned return to Saudi Arabia in 2028, organizers Amaury Sport Organisation and Saudi Motorsport Company said in a statement Sunday. Fitz joins tight end J.V. Cain (88), two-way player Marshall Goldberg (99), tackle Stan Mauldin (77), safety Larry Wilson (8), and of course Pat Tillman (40). Fitzgerald is the 16th player who spent all or a significant part of his career with the Cardinals and is the first one who is truly Arizona in his career.

stories.summary: The Florida Gators were on a bye during Week 8 but that didn't stop the Orange and Blue from rising again in ESPN's Football Power Index. The FPI measures team strength and is meant to be the best predictor of a team's performance for the rest of the season; it shows how many points above or below average a team is. Each team is assigned a rating that measures its true strength on a net-points scale, as well as its expected point margin against an average opponent on a neutral field. Projected results are based on 20,000 season simulations using FPI and the schedule. Take a look at how Florida's numbers shake out after Week 8's gridiron action.
